title: Dance of the Sugar Plum Fairy (Celesta Etude)
director_summary: A crystalline music-box staging where Aurelia awakens in a hushed violet theater, tiptoes across chromatic celesta descents, leaps through staccato woodwind arpeggios, and erupts into a golden stardust grand-jeté climax when the full harmonic tremolos bloom at 17.0s.

character.name: Aurelia the Sugar-Plum Sprite
character.concept: A translucent porcelain-and-starlight ballerina who lives inside an enchanted Victorian celesta mechanism, converting bell chimes into crystalline light.
character.style: Luminous geometric storybook ballet with glass-refraction wings and glowing filigree

sections.name: Hushed Pizzicato & Chromatic Prelude
sections.background: Dimmed velvet music-box stage with softly rotating brass gears

sections.name: Sparkling Arpeggio Development
sections.background: Crystalline arches illuminating in sync with rising woodwind figures

sections.name: Grand Celesta & Tremolo Climax
sections.background: Full golden aurora dome with cascading chime constellations

sections.name: Dissolving Music-Box Coda
sections.background: Twilight violet fade with suspended crystal motes

events.why: The iconic high G-F# celesta bell enters after the sparse pizzicato intro; Aurelia awakens from her music-box slumber with a crisp, bell-like curtsey bounce.
Strongest onset of the opening phrase lands on the descending chromatic step; Aurelia tiptoes left in exact sync with the pointed staccato articulation.
The second descending celesta statement mirrors the first one step lower, prompting a symmetrical counter-step to the right to balance the stage composition.
As the descending chromatic line reaches its lower register turn, Aurelia raises her chime-wand overhead to catch the lingering harmonic overtones.
A sudden burst of rapid ascending arpeggios breaks the hushed prelude at 9.52s; Aurelia launches into a buoyant leap that inaugurates the playful development section.
Repeating bell-like arpeggio figures swirl upward in pitch; a rapid pirouette visually translates the circular melodic figure into spinning stardust trails.
The sequential pattern intensifies toward the climax; a second high leap punctuates the crest of the arpeggio wave.
Tension peaks right before the sweeping upward run; Aurelia coils into a fast preparatory spin that gathers golden particles toward the center of the stage.
A brilliant ascending glissando erupts at 17.0s into sustained fortissimo tremolos; throwing both arms skyward unleashes the full golden aurora burst at the exact structural downbeat.
The final solitary E-minor celesta bell rings out at 30.02s and decays into silence; Aurelia freezes in a crystalline reverence pose as the music box winds down.

climax.description: Triggered by a sweeping upward glissando at 16.97s, the texture shifts from sparse staccato notes to dense, shimmering upper-register tremolos with nearly 3x the average energy and spectral brightness of the intro.
climax.visual_boost: Golden aurora stardust storm + 1.25x dynamic camera zoom + radiant halo bloom around Aurelia's wings
